title: Publish FFTA DE-ReBuild 1.1.2
changes: Publish release 1.1.2 with the Android laws and exit fixes, warning-free platform builds and the desktop cancellation fix.
validation: GitHub reports v1.1.2 as public and latest; all nine assets matched local sizes and SHA-256 digests after upload.
The annotated tag resolves to source commit 2cb0f457191f064cf4868edd51995ff259dfe870; remote main and decomp were fast-forwarded to that source commit.
Linux, Windows/Wine and Android build/test gates passed; the final Android APK was installed on the moto g34 with six save and snapshot files unchanged.
limitations: Windows was tested under Wine, not native Windows. The optional host Wine smoke could not start because the shared prefix was leased.
Android remains a debug-signed preview; a full cold installation of every SDK package was not exercised.
